route_evidence.method: Read the official public JavaScript as text; no execution or authentication

actual_description: A 25-part platform for exploring cellular odor sensing: ten Drosophila tuning-receptor CDSs, ten OR-IRES-mCherry modules, a GCaMP6f-Orco fusion and four fusion components. The design combines interchangeable tuning receptors with a shared calcium reporter in mammalian cells. Documentation connects sequence sources and architecture diagrams to labelled colony plates, undigested DNA gels, fixed-cell fluorescence and two separately documented exploratory plate batches. Measured conditions include exact image-object denominators, threshold sensitivity, within-stage fluorescence changes, baseline-drift subtraction, vehicle comparisons and untransfected controls. Basic components were not tested independently. The records support reuse of the design and analysis, but do not yet establish receptor specificity, membrane localization or a validated detection limit.
